# Chataptor for Shoper — Professional Live Chat for Your Store

Canonical URL: https://chataptor.com/cs/integrations/shoper/
Markdown URL: https://chataptor.com/markdown/cs/integrations/shoper.md
Language: Čeština (cs)
Add a modern live chat widget to your Shoper store. Customer identification, agent dashboard, and AI translations. Chataptor is currently free with no message limits.

## Overview
Live chat built for Shoper
A professional chat widget tailored to your Shoper store. Automatic identification of logged-in customers, conversation history and AI translations — ready the moment you install it.

## Key Features
- Widget matched to your store: Elegant, responsive design with configurable colors and position. Loaded asynchronously — your store stays fast.
- Logged-in customer identification: Automatic recognition of Shoper customers — you see the shopper's name and email in the agent dashboard without extra questions.
- Agent dashboard: Intuitive interface for handling multiple conversations at once. Sound and push notifications, full conversation history, browser-based access.
- AI translations: Customers write in their language, you answer in yours. Chataptor translates messages in real time with DeepL and OpenAI.
- Real-time notifications: Never miss a message — push, email and sound notifications keep you informed of new inquiries instantly.
- No-code setup: Install from Shoper App Store, authorize OAuth access, done. The widget appears in your store without touching any template.
- Security & GDPR: TLS 1.3 encryption, OAuth tokens secured with AES-256-GCM, EU-based servers, full GDPR compliance.
- Conversation history: Full archive of conversations tied to the customer profile. Jump back into context in seconds.

## How It Works
- Install from Shoper App Store: Find "Chataptor Live Chat" in Shoper App Store and click Install. The app appears in your store's application list.
- Authorize OAuth access: Confirm permissions (shop_read, scripts_write). A Chataptor account is created automatically from your Shoper data.
- Widget active in your store: The chat widget shows up in your store's footer. Customers can start chatting right away — no extra configuration.
- Reply in the agent dashboard: Sign in to chataptor.com and answer messages. Logged-in Shoper customers arrive with their name and email.

## Platform Fit
Perfectly matched to Shoper
Deep integration with the Shoper API — the widget runs natively, without conflicts with your store template.
- Store integration: Widget injected automatically via the Shoper scripts API. No manual template edits or PHP code.
- OAuth 2.0: Secure authorization using the OAuth 2.0 standard. Tokens are encrypted and stored in the EU.
- Shoper customer data: Logged-in Shoper customers are recognized automatically — name and email land directly in the agent dashboard.

## Technical Requirements
- Shoper: 5+
- Subscription: Active
- Browser: Chrome/FF/Safari
- Certificate: SSL

## FAQ
### How much does Chataptor for Shoper cost?
Chataptor is currently free and does not limit messages. You can launch live chat, handle store messages, and test automatic translations without a separate budget upfront.

### What do I need to install Chataptor?
You only need an active Shoper store and a modern browser (Chrome, Firefox, Safari, Edge). No server configuration or code edits — the app installs from the Shoper App Store in two clicks.

### Is my data and my customers' data secure?
Yes. We use TLS 1.3 encryption for all connections, OAuth tokens are secured with AES-256-GCM and all data is stored exclusively on servers in the European Union. We are fully GDPR compliant, use two-factor authentication for the dashboard and perform regular encrypted backups.

### What customer data does Chataptor collect?
During a chat session we collect: first and last name and email (only if the customer is logged in to Shoper or provides them in a form), message content, IP address and browser data. We do not have access to your product catalog, orders, payment data or customer passwords.

### How do I uninstall the app?
Just uninstall the Chataptor application from the Shoper application panel — the widget is automatically removed from your store. We keep data for 30 more days (in case of reactivation), after which it is permanently deleted. On request we can delete it earlier.

### Where can I get support?
The support team replies at support@chataptor.com within 24 hours on business days. Online documentation and the status.chataptor.com page with service availability are also available.

### Does Chataptor support multiple languages?
Yes. Real-time automatic translations are currently available in Chataptor for free. Customers write in their language, you reply in yours, and Chataptor translates the conversation automatically.
